title: should render the multi-select 'Select All' master row and select all values
verifies: the multi-select master row renders and clicking it checks the box and sets the trigger to <ALL>

title: should clear the selection when 'Select All' is toggled off
verifies: toggling 'Select All' off unchecks the master box and clears the <ALL> value

title: should select all and close the popover via the single-select 'All' row
verifies: the single-select 'All' row sets <ALL> and closes the popover immediately

title: should auto-check 'Select All' when every option is hand-ticked
verifies: hand-ticking every option auto-checks the master row while keeping an explicit value list

title: should uncheck 'Select All' when one option is unticked
verifies: unticking one option unchecks the master row
